keyEvents.text: Alfie Kilgour (Bristol Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Liam Bennett (Cambridge United) is shown the yellow card for dangerous play.
Goal! Bristol Rovers 1, Cambridge United 0. Reiss-Alexander Russell-Denny (Bristol Rovers) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Clinton Mola.
Tommy Leigh (Bristol Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Bristol Rovers 2, Cambridge United 0. Fabrizio Cavegn (Bristol Rovers) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Tom James.
Ben Purrington (Bristol Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Clinton Mola (Bristol Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Attempt saved. Clinton Mola (Bristol Rovers) right footed shot from outside the box is saved.
